title: firmware/bridge-zephyr pubkey_to_iid uses SHA-256, diverging from spec 03 SHA-512 IID derivation
description: RECREATED 2026-09-09 ~23:31Z by the 02a-tdma sweep worker: the original bead (created 2026-09-09T23:04:22Z, id project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.156) was clobbered by an ID-counter collision when the TDMA sweep created its own b7z9.156; bd sequence state was stale per store corruption tracked in project-LICHEN-worker6-rul5. Content below is verbatim from the pre-clobber bd list output. -- Spec: spec/03-addressing.md 3.1 derivation step 2-3 (sweep 2026-09-09, R-03-003): IID = SHA-512(pubkey)[0:8] with U/L cleared, MUST be identical across all implementations. Divergent: firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen/ipv6_addr.c:85-118 derives the IID from SHA-256(pubkey) (explicit SECURITY comment, ORCHID-inspired), while the live lichen/ tree (lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.c:166-180 crypto_sha512), Rust (rust/lichen-core/src/addr.rs:84-90) and Python (python/src/lichen/crypto/identity.py:138-154) all use SHA-512. firmware/bridge-zephyr is still an active build target: python/tests/firmware/test_bridge_zephyr_cmake.py checks its CMake/Kconfig/boards and auto-merges board files (t1000_e, t_echo, rak4631, etc.). An IID mismatch breaks link-local address interop (fe80::/10) and human_address agreement with the other stacks. Suggested placement: port firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen/ipv6_addr.c lichen_pubkey_to_iid to crypto_sha512 (Monocypher, as done for lichen/ in bead l1qw.4.5.2.3), or retire the legacy tree if it is no longer a shipping target; add a node-address vector consumer test for it either way.
